units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 7:10">Targ. Job VII, 10</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 78:17">Targ. Ps. LXXVIII, 17</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Nazir 20b:6">Naz. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>ת׳ לא שבקת וכ׳</he> thou allowest no more room for the disciple (no more than three words of greeting); a. e.—With <cite ref="S00299"><he>ן</he></cite>: <cite ref="V00151"><he>תּוּבָן</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:1:10">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵇ</cite> <he>ומה הויתה דריש ת׳</he> and what more hast thou been teaching? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 3:4:3">Y. Taan. III, 66ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>נדר … דלא למיעבד כן ת׳</he> he vowed that he would never do it again.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 2:5:3">Y. B. Mets. II, 8ᶜ</cite> top <he>מן כדון … לעי ת׳</he> henceforth thou shalt no longer have to work (for a living); a. e.—V. <cite ref="V00134"><he>תּוּ</he> II</cite>.
